paraphrase: Open premise: whatever unites two things into x is an efficient cause of x in some respect. Stated by SCG I.18 n.4, Componens autem est causa efficiens compositi, where the componens is that by which things plural in themselves are united into one (claim AQUINAS-SCG-I-18-COMPOSER-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE); the premise asserts only efficient causing in some respect, weaker than the source's efficient cause of the composite. ST I q.3 a.7 co., third proof, motivates but does not state it.
